objective: Make the Cloud IaC GitOps evidence gate fail closed when signed-image Helm parameter values are orphaned or paired with the wrong parameter names.

best_practice_sources.what_it_establishes: Argo CD supports Helm parameter name/value configuration in Application sources; this ChangeSet validates local name/value pairing without running Argo CD or Helm.
Argo CD Application manifests model source/Helm settings and sync policy; this slice remains local template validation only.
Cosign verification requires explicit verification execution; this ChangeSet preserves local signed-image render inputs but does not claim verification execution.
Admission policy enforcement is a separate runtime concern; this local gate does not claim admission enforcement.
Kubernetes signed-artifact verification is evidence-bearing runtime work; this ChangeSet only hardens local GitOps template inputs.

red_tests.summary: The GitOps evidence gate accepted a fixture where image.digest had the wrong adjacent value and {{signed_image_digest}} appeared under image.cosign.required.

verification.summary: Focused GitOps evidence tests passed, including signed-image Helm parameter name/value pair drift rejection.

verification.command: oya gate validate cloud-iac-gitops-evidence; oya gate validate cloud-iac-cell-topology
verification.summary: Live GitOps evidence and cell-topology gates passed against the repo-local templates/topology.

verification.summary: Rust formatting, scoped package check, and clippy warnings-as-errors passed for oya-dev-cli.

No new TODO/FIXME/HACK/fallback bypass was introduced. The code hit is Iterator::skip in the pair scanner, and remaining hits are prior documented temporary OpenTofu-copy/credential prose and historical skipped-test wording.

verification.summary: Oya VCS work, verify, done --controller-promote, and promote accepted for the ChangeSet.

verification.summary: Post-promote strict dependency-seam, scoped honest-claims, scoped retired-vocabulary, JSON/audit parsing, and whitespace diff checks passed after lifecycle evidence/audit/task updates.

implemented_claims: The GitOps evidence gate now validates image.digest as a Helm parameter name immediately paired with value {{signed_image_digest}}.
The GitOps evidence gate now validates image.cosign.required as a Helm parameter name immediately paired with value true.
Orphan value lines or values under the wrong parameter names no longer satisfy signed-image parameter coherence.
The Cloud IaC manifest records these local pair invariants and non-claims.
explicit_non_claims: No Helm rendering, cosign verification command, image signing, admission-controller enforcement, Argo CD API, Kubernetes API, Helm CLI, or live sync/diff/health/prune/self-heal is implemented.

No deployed endpoint, production auth/Cedar runtime, provider runtime, tofu plan/apply/state, object-store integration, FD-001 tenant workload hosting, production readiness, hyperscaler readiness, or cloud provisioning is claimed.
false_green_findings_closed: The GitOps evidence gate can no longer pass a template where signed-image placeholder values exist as independent lines but are paired with the wrong Helm parameter names.
known_gaps: Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required is not claimed green.
Aggregate ./bin/oya gate run-all is not claimed green unless freshly rerun and proven.
This is a local template text gate only; live Helm rendering, cosign/admission, Argo CD/Kubernetes evidence remains future work.

findings: Small deterministic scanner closes a real false-green without adding a YAML parser dependency or runtime calls.
Strengthens the GitOps supply-chain contract by enforcing signed-image render inputs as coherent pairs before tenant rollout evidence.
RED fixture proved orphan/wrong-pair values passed before the fix; GREEN rejects the drift.
Template authors receive precise local diagnostics for the parameter whose paired value drifted.
Focused tests, live gates, fmt/check/clippy, governance gates, and scoped Cloud IaC suite passed.

alternatives_named: Add YAML parser and structural Application model
Use bounded name/value pair scanner now
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: The pair scanner closes the immediate false-green while staying local, deterministic, and dependency-free.
rejected_reasons: Full Helm rendering requires chart inputs and a broader render-evidence slice.
A YAML parser dependency is unnecessary for the current fixed template contract and would widen dependency-seam scope.

findings: The gate now prevents signed-image placeholder orphaning while still rejecting credential-like template material.
Adds a small bounded text scan over five local templates; no runtime serving path or network I/O is affected.
Improves traceability of signed-image intent; compliance-grade render/admission/signature evidence remains non-claimed.
Live templates already had correct pairs, so the gate hardens existing contract without changing template output.
Bad template edits fail before later sync/deploy work can depend on malformed image digest inputs.
ChangeSet is tied to Oya VCS claim, tests, manifest/tasks, evidence, and audit-chain rows.
Used Oya VCS claim, avoided raw git/gh, kept /plan complementary-only, and did not claim production/hyperscaler completion.
No new dependencies were introduced; strict dependency-seam is run at closeout.

review_findings: No critical/high issue found for local gate scope. Live rendering/signing/admission verification remains explicitly non-claimed.
